pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.
   C. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   C. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Use Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of Sharia? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of Sharia.
   B. Use Secondary sources of Sharia to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Secondary sources of Sharia has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq .
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Ijtihad and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Founders of Schools of jurisprudence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. B — Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

12. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ijtihad; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
